read_bytes_from_file: create a python module that uses LocalBackend to read raw bytes from a local file path
write_text_to_file: create a python module that uses LocalBackend put_text to write a string to a local file with utf-8 encoding
check_file_exists: create a python module that uses LocalBackend exists to check if a given file path exists on disk
copy_file_locally: create a python module that uses LocalBackend copyfile to copy a source file to a destination path
list_directory_recursively: create a python module that uses LocalBackend list_dir_or_file to recursively list files and directories in a path
